purpose: Teach: 勝てる/そろえ/置け/絞ら/読み直し/在り方/実装/低減

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、君は学界で勝てる力を持っている
lines.en: Ren — you have the capacity to compete in the academic world.
lines.style: Calm, measured opening. Direct eye contact. Weight on 「勝てる力」—a genuine acknowledgment of potential, not flattery. Steady pace, composed authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文の資料をそろえております
lines.en: Yes. I've been gathering the research materials.
lines.style: Respectful but not stiff. Quiet focus, like reporting progress to someone who expects thoroughness. Slight eagerness underneath the formality—wanting to show readiness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究器具を置ける場所、確保しろ
lines.en: Ren — secure a space where you can set up your equipment.
lines.style: Practical instruction, no hesitation. Clear and direct. A mentor who trusts the student will handle this. Brief pause after the name, then the task unfolds with quiet certainty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究テーマを絞らせていただきました
lines.en: Yes. I've narrowed my research focus.
lines.style: Calm report. Respectful register—formal enough to show deference, but the words are genuine. A small lift of satisfaction at having made the decision. Not breathless, just present.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、論文を読み直して投稿しろ
lines.en: Ren — read the paper through again and submit it.
lines.style: Direct instruction, slightly firmer than before. No room for negotiation, but not unkind. The tone of someone who sees the work is close to ready and is pushing gently forward.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究者の在り方を考えております
lines.en: Yes. I've been reflecting on what it means to be a researcher.
lines.style: Quiet, thoughtful response. Slower pace—this is something he's genuinely considered. A trace of uncertainty in the delivery, like he's still turning this over. Respectful but sincere, not just compliance.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、新アルゴリズムを実装しろ
lines.style: Expectation without doubt. Clipped, efficient delivery. A mentor who has moved past reassurance into clear task assignment. The name carries weight—this is for someone ready to handle it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験コストの低減に努めております
lines.en: Yes. I'm working to reduce the experimental costs.
lines.style: Focused response with careful control. A thread of determination underneath—he's thinking about efficiency and responsibility. Measured pace, slight tailing off as if considering what else needs to be done. Respectful close.
